prompt: Why does the guide recommend against taking all the starter?
promptZh: 為什麼指南不建議帶走所有酸種？

options.text: The cooler bag needs room for the starter to expand.
options.zh: 保冷袋內需保留空間讓酸種膨脹。
options.whyZh: 指南沒有提到膨脹，留一份在家是為了有備用酸種。

options.text: Any starter that travels has to be used before the journey ends.
options.zh: 帶上路的酸種必須在旅程結束前用完。
options.whyZh: 指南只說要回溫後再餵，未規定用完期限。

options.text: A fuller jar is more likely to freeze during the trip.
options.zh: 越滿的罐子在途中越容易結凍。
options.whyZh: 指南把局部結凍風險歸於玻璃與保冷劑接觸，不是罐子裝得滿。

options.text: It leaves something to bake with if the traveling portion is lost.
options.zh: 旅行時帶的那份若損失，仍有別份可用來烤麵包。
options.whyZh: 旅行用罐可能破損或灑出，家中保留的同批酸種可以備用。

explanationZh: 旅行用罐可能破損或灑出，家中保留的同批酸種可以備用。
evidence: Keep the rest in its usual container at home. / If the travel jar cracks or spills, you'll still have enough to bake another batch after your trip.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Keep the rest in its usual container at home.
If the travel jar cracks or spills, you'll still have enough to bake another batch after your trip.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指從同一批酸種分出少量帶上路。
